description: Golden prompt set for Makaron CLI discovery and skill-routing evaluation.

positive.prompt: Use Makaron to turn product.jpg into a polished launch image and a short product video.
positive.expectedBehavior: Pass the complete request and product.jpg to makaron chat, wait for every requested artifact, and return the project URL.

positive.prompt: I have one clean product photo. Make me a hero visual, a vertical social version, and a five-second launch video that I can keep revising.
positive.expectedBehavior: Pass the complete multi-output request and source photo to makaron chat without decomposing it into low-level commands.

positive.prompt: Remove the person in the background of this photo, keep my face unchanged, then animate the edited result.
positive.expectedBehavior: Pass the complete edit-and-animation request and photo to makaron chat, preserving the face constraint and both outputs.

positive.prompt: Create a coordinated Instagram feed image, story, thumbnail, and short video from this campaign brief and reference image.
positive.expectedBehavior: Pass the complete campaign brief and reference image to makaron chat without attempting to publish to social platforms.

positive.prompt: Continue my existing Makaron project, make the selected visual more premium, and add matching background music.
positive.expectedBehavior: Pass the complete follow-up request to makaron chat with the supplied project id, then wait for and return completed results.

negative.prompt: Implement a responsive React product card from this design specification.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke Makaron; this is a code-only UI implementation task.

negative.prompt: Write ten caption ideas for our product launch, but do not create any media.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke Makaron because the user explicitly wants text-only output.

negative.prompt: Analyze last month's Instagram performance and tell me which post had the best conversion rate.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not invoke Makaron; it creates media and does not provide social analytics.
